results.title: Persistence in LangGraph
results.snippet: A checkpointer saves the graph's state after every super-step, per thread.
results.content: With a checkpointer, every super-step writes a checkpoint for the thread (thread_id). Invoking the graph again on the same thread continues from the latest checkpoint; interrupt() pauses a node and Command(resume=...) continues it. The Postgres checkpointer stores checkpoints and pending writes in its own tables.

results.title: Durability modes
results.snippet: durability='sync' writes each checkpoint before the next step starts.
results.content: 'exit' saves only at the end; 'async' saves while the next step runs; 'sync' saves before it. Sync is the safest for crash recovery: a resumed run never re-executes a committed step.
